name: Robust Summarization Evaluation (RoSE)
description: RoSE is a large human evaluation benchmark for summarization consisting of 22,000 summary-level annotations over 28 top-performing systems on three datasets. It enables robust evaluation of summarization systems and automatic metrics with high inter-annotator agreement using Atomic Content Units (ACUs).
reputation: A well-regarded human evaluation benchmark for summarization that is widely used to assess both system quality and the reliability of automatic metrics.
notes: Focuses on improving human evaluation protocols for summarization; introduces ACUs for fine-grained semantic units.
